notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.8
notes.notes: [p]Hey folks! [/p][p][/p][p]We've just released a hotfix (Build 1.0.8) for an issue where Steam Achievements were not registering, caused by a bug introduced with the 1.0.7 update on June 26th (last Thursday), meaning any Steam Achievements earned during this period were not activating. [/p][p][/p][p]As the bulk of the achievements in Axyz are tied to collecting the tapes, beating the high scores and completing the levels for each World, you should be able to unlock any missing achievements simply by beating a level in any previous World you have completed. [/p][p][/p][p]For example, if you collected all tapes and high scores for each level in World 1 (and thus completed World 1), you should be able to unlock the 3 achievements tied to these objectives simply by beating any level in World 1 (just grab the key and head to the exit!). [/p][p][/p][p]If you collected all the tapes but not all the high scores, you will only earn the achievements for the tapes and beating World 1. [/p][p][/p][p]If you continue to run into any issues, please let us know! [/p][p]You can also jump into our [url="https://discord.gg/SbjFtqPgBz"]Discord[/url] to provide a report. [/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[b]Patch v1.0.6.[/b]

A big thank you to everyone who picked up a copy of Axyz since the start of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!

We've got a small patch with some new accessibility features: 

[list]
[*] Added an option to turn off post-processing features
[*] Added a slider to increase or decrease barrier opacity
[/list]

You can check these settings from the settings menu during gameplay to see the changes in real time!

We're looking to expand the accessibility features of Axyz. While we have some ideas that we're looking to implement, we're also open to suggestions from the community, so please let us know!

Have a great weekend! 

xoxo

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hey folks! A new patch is here!

We've noticed that players often move directly from core levels to the bonus levels of a specific world, which can lead to a significant increase in difficulty. We've tweaked the flow so that the game encourages you to play through all the core levels first and then head back to the bonus levels.

We've also locked off the bonus levels till you have completed all 10 core levels for that respective world.

Selecting Streamer Mode was causing a couple of issues with certain songs. This has now been fixed, and all tracks safe for streaming mode will play correctly!

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where, sometimes, certain streaming-safe tracks would always be skipped during streamer mode.
[*] Bonus levels are now only playable after completing all core levels in their respective world.
[*] Improved loading times when scrolling through locked levels during level selection.
[*] Updated credits to include the contributor for Japanese localization.
[/list]

Thank you, as always, for your reports and feedback!

xoxo

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello folks! 

Two posts in one day? We promise not to make a habit out of it. 

Firstly, we just want to give a massive thank you to everyone who has purchased, played or reviewed the game since Thursday. We are so incredibly grateful for the support, streams and feedback we've recieved since then. 

As you can understand, we took a few days to recharge but we've been paying close attention to feedback and reports, and while we don't have a lot of changes to report right now - we'll be looking at ways to improve the experience for players.

You're also likely wondering what happened to patches 1.0.1 and 1.0.2 - They happened as the game went live and were for relatively minor changes - so it wouldn't have made sense to post immediately after announcing the game's release, but to make sure you're up to speed we've included them below! 

[b]Patch v1.0.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed jumping into two spikes and rewinding would remove two rewinds instead of one
[/list]

[b]Patch v1.0.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Irish language support added
[*] Fixed an issue with window mode dropdown not closing correctly
[/list]

[b]Patch v1.0.3[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a minor French localization issue
[*] Changed the Irish language dropdown option from 'Gaelige' to 'Irish'
[*] Removed unintended tapes from bonus level 3A
[*] Changed main menu computer desktop background
[*] Fixed an issue where jumping on multiple springs in a row could sometimes cause the ball to move less distance than intended
[/list]

Please consider joining our [url=https://discord.gg/2KSt5rWD]Discord [/url]to provide feedback, chat with other Axyz fans and to send across any bug reports!

notes.title: Steam Deck Update
notes.notes:
Hey folks! Just want to give a quick note about Axyz on Steam Deck. 

We made an original post about this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2850490/view/543349604658184884?l=english]here [/url]a few weeks ago but there's been some updates since then. 

We've managed to fix the outlying issues we had, which means the following: 
- The game recognises you're playing on Steam Deck and will lock the resolution to 1280x720
- Menu navigation is fully working with Dpad

The only thing that you might notice is the game will use XBox controller glyphs instead of the Steam Deck glyphs. We'll likely figure that out at some point but it should not make any difference to your experience with the game. 

We've also yet to configure Steam Cloud saving but we're hoping to get that added in soon. 

We'd love to get the game Steam Deck verified but we currently can't do much till Valve takes notice of us *waves hands furiously in the air*

notes.title: Demo Update 0.0.7v
notes.notes:
Another day, another patch!

We've added a Vsync toggle and the ability to lock the frame rate at 60.

We've also made a couple of small visual adjustments to improve the clarity of barriers and when you collect tapes.

[list]
[*] Added frame rate limit and Vsync options to the settings menu.
[*] Adjusted music volume for a more consistent audio experience across tracks.
[*] Uncollected tapes now appear more transparent to better distinguish them from collected ones.
[*] Brightened barrier material for improved visibility.
[/list]


We're also excited to announce that speedrun data for auto-splitter support has been implemented and that Nikoheart, a member of the speedrunning community, will be uploading a Livesplitter for the Axyz demo soon!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.0.6v
notes.notes:
Hello and happy Steam Next Fest day! In celebration of this momentous occasion we came with another patch! ːsteamhappyː

Some of the things added are futureproofing for updates in the future i.e more language support, but we are happy to say the game now has full support for both German and French speakers. 

We've greatly improved the smoothness of camera movement. You should notice this when jumping or gravity switching. 

We've also fixed a few minor visual issues for good measure.  

[list]
[*] Updated UI in preparation for additional languages
[*] Updated fonts in preparation for additional languages
[*] Added French and German language support
[*] Added a word missing in the movement tutorial
[*] Added automatic scrolling to dropdown elements in the settings menu
[*] Improved smoothness when jumping/falling below your current horizontal position
[*] Coins and gems no longer respawn in a level after being collected when transitioning to the victory screen
[*] Fixed an issue that caused certain song names to not scroll correctly in the HUD
[/list]

You can send additional reports through Steam or on our Discord! 

(also please ignore we skipped 0.0.5v)

notes.title: Demo Update 0.0.4
notes.notes:
Hey folks, we're back with another update *[i]so soon you say?[/i]*

This is a slightly bigger update, with some work under the hood done to implement stuff in a future patch. 
The biggest change you should notice is the initial launch load time. We've reduced it from around 45 seconds to 3.... which is quite good. ⌛ 
Also, we now have Steam Achievements specific to the demo! 🏆 

[list]
[*] Exiting a level now takes you to the level section screen
[*] Added steam achievements for the demo
[*] Greatly improved the app's initial loading time
[*] Locked frame rate to 60 fps
[*] Changed bonus level ID naming convention
[*] Fixed an issue where inputs would show as text instead of the input device icon when an input device gets disconnected and then reconnected
[*] Fixed an issue where changing levels in the level select in rapid succession could cause multiple levels to be loaded at the same time
[*] Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, the rewinding animation would play indefinitely and wouldn't send you back to the last safe block
[*] Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, high scores wouldn't update after they were recorded for the first time
[/list]

You can send additional reports through Steam or on our [url=https://discord.gg/AGJ97FRX]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Final update for the year!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! As we begin to wrap up for the year I just want to take a moment to reflect on what a crazy past 12 months it has been. 

Since January 1st we've showcased in 4 countries at 11 events, had hundreds, probably thousands of players spend time playing Axyz, talk to us, give us feedback, and some of you were even kind enough to wishlist the game. 

Outside of making the game, this has easily been my most favourite part of the whole experience and I just want to say thank you for making this the most fun year I've had on a professional level. 

We're now entering the busiest part of the development window as we try to get this thing out the door, and we've been fortunate enough to bring on some incredibly talented people to help us get across the finishing line. They've already made some noticible differences and I cannot wait to see how the game evolves between now and release day. 

We're edging closer towards a personal goal of reaching 1K wishlists, so if you know anyone who would be interested in puzzlegames, vaporwave or PSX era vibes - be sure to send them on a link to the steam page! 

For now, have a very merry christmas and happy new year. We'll see you in 2025. 

ciao.
Mark
xxx
